## Checklist

- [ ] `node --test "test/*.test.mjs"` passes, and new behaviour has a test.
- [ ] No npm packages.
- [ ] Tests, examples and screenshots use invented people only; nothing from a real profile.
- [ ] Text a person reads is plain English, with no em dashes or en dashes.
- [ ] Like, pass and send still run exactly once.

## For a new site only

- [ ] `site.json` records the terms: the date, every page read, the verdict, the sentences quoted.
- [ ] The verdict is `allowed` or `silent`. Nothing in the terms forbids bots, automated access or
      third-party tools.
- [ ] `godspeed-wingman site check <id>` passes, and the adapter never clicks or taps anything that
      changes something while reading.
